All sixteen objects individually cuttable, full silhouettes, distinct shapes, no magenta color on objects.

params.prompt: Game inventory icon atlas, exactly 6 columns and 3 rows, 18 equal square cells edge to edge, no gutters, NO TEXT. Painterly high end folklore MOBA equipment icons, vibrant magical glow on midnight navy backgrounds, crisp recognizable silhouettes occupying central 75 percent of each cell. Row 1 left to right: sharpened ivory bone shard, cyan swift feather, violet ember gemstone, engraved iron plate, glowing green heart seed, silver pouch spilling moon dust. Row 2: curved ivory nightfang dagger teal aura, red blood talisman amulet, lightning storm talon claw, witch lantern with violet flame, frosty blue bell, living thorn root crown. Row 3: silver moon boots, mystical mirror cloak, ancient grave bell green spirit, hunter’s bone crossbow, quickthorn red spiked thorn blade, beacon heart gold crystal. Consistent three quarter view painted volume, rim light, detailed materials. Square icons packed 6x3 in 2:1 canvas. No words, letters, numbers, borders, grids or UI.

processing: Cropped cells, chroma-key magenta removal, repacked 16 sprites, transparent WebP and four portraits. Ground atlas converted to WebP. Geometry, fog, UI and effects are native code. Real 3D GLBs replace battlefield creature and scenery sprites. Shader deformation animates creatures; native geometry supplies wisps, wards, bridge planks and tactical effects.
limitations: Real textured 3D GLBs with procedural vertex animation. No authored skeletal clips or online multiplayer. 404-GEN remains unconnected. Meshy advertised lowpoly in the schema but rejected that enum; shipped models use the supported smart-topology mode.
